summary: All 72 combined tests and the doctor pass. Exact Ogg comparisons fix ADV-1. The new D5 class lacks exact-line tests and misses output-folder creation failures.
blocking_findings: F6 [Blocker] review-a: spec.md:52-54 and AC2 require exact-line assertions for every D5 class, including the new row at line 70. tests/sound-set.adversarial.test.ts:211-226 still asserts only one line and a sound-set prefix. Its comments incorrectly say D5 defines no exact text. The original test file has no case for this class, and test-strategy.md:74-87 still lists only the previous classes. A wrong message, sound-set: wrong message, passes these stderr assertions. Fix: add exact substituted-line assertions for the new class, preserve the exit and directory-content checks, and update the strategy.

F7 [Blocker] review-a: the new spec.md:73-75 contract covers filesystem failures during output preparation, but scripts/sound-set.mjs:74 creates the output folder outside the new handler. A file at sounds/<set> causes an uncaught mkdir error before the controlled line. The isolated ENOTDIR fixture produced no wrapper stderr line and no child call. This also contradicts plan.md:187-189, which claims any filesystem exception is contained. Fix: contain output-folder creation and target preparation in the same contract. Add exact-line tests for folder obstruction and preparation I/O failures.
nonblocking_findings: F5 [Nit] review-a: plan.md:165 retains the legacy deferred marker described in review-a-7fbf58b.json. The project parser does not count [b] tasks. Keep this compatibility issue with closeout or separate tooling work; it does not block the sound implementation.

F1 remains closed: the passing stale-target regressions require a current write and reject a no-write child. F2 remains closed: ordered call logs include the failed call and exclude later calls.
